newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's February trade deficit $681 million.
newsitem.headline: Israel's February trade deficit $681 million.

text.p: Israel's trade deficit in February totalled $681.3 million, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.
Note - Figures are in millions of dollars.

The bureau said the February figure reflected the continued decline in the trade deficit that began in second-quarter 1996. It said, however, that the rate of decline had slowed to 2.3 percent a month this year from 4.5 percent in second-half 1996.

The decline in merchandise imports (not counting ships, planes, diamonds and fuel) had slowed to a monthly average of 0.8 percent since October 1996, down from a rate of 1.1 percent to 1.4 percent in May-September, the bureau said.
Export growth also moderated to 0.3 percent on average since October 1996 from 0.7 percent in the four months prior to that, the bureau said.
